control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 30 %, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through a tunnel and get out on the other side.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 30 %

branches.reason: In the simulator the light never falls below 40 %: a tunnel is 40 % at the darkest, so this condition never holds.
branches.outcome: the light is below 30 %: it drives forward at 30 % in the dark
the light is 30 % or more: it goes on to stopAtWall
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
nothing is ahead: it goes on to followLine
